about: Every run in this local store is superseded: none may be used for scoring. They stay in place (and in git history) as a record. The suite of record is t3-incidents-v4 (sha256 128b229489d3b1e050223a03c7a23bb2e0bec995cb480a6e44552d2d51984638), frozen on x86_64 in SageMaker by run t3.evals.suite-freeze-20261103T031439Z-32b3; its baselines are re-measured as tools/sm/run.py jobs and their evidence lives in the team's S3 evidence prefix.

superseded.reason: suite v2 was frozen on t3/evals' stand-in twin; after W2's twin.replay (ran-rl 1.2.9 Maveric, user-share-weighted pooled p10 KPIs) merged, its frozen KPIs no longer replay.

suite v3 was frozen on the real twin but on Apple arm64, and these runs ran locally (not as runner jobs). The twin is a float32 GP: an x86_64 SageMaker job could not replay v3 to the 1e-6 tolerance (inc-off-mas-4102-tilt+5), and the x86 freeze differs from the arm64 one by up to 0.038 in a KPI. Superseded by suite v4 (x86_64) and its runner-job baselines.

superseded_by.baselines: re-measured as runner jobs (no_action, rule_baseline, config_revert, config_revert on the masked tier); run ids recorded when they land
